entities.title: Replay every score
entities.summary: The server never takes a score from the browser; it replays the match.
entities.context: A browser can send anything; a public table is worthless if scores can be typed in.

options.title: Issue the seed and replay the recorded controls
options.consequences: A replay per submission, about 5 ms for a 10-minute match; the engine must be deterministic.

entities.decision: The server issues each match's seed, stores it unused, and on submission replays the recording with the same engine, marks the seed used and stores the replay's score.
entities.rationale: Only what the match really scored can be listed, and each seed only once.
